_comment: Reference prices per model id. Copy to backend/runtime/model_pricing.json (or point MODEL_PRICING_PATH at it) and fill in the figures from each provider's price list. A model that is not listed is recorded as unpriced. Keys match by the longest id contained in the model name, so 'seedance-2-5' also prices 'doubao-seedance-2-5-pro-xxxx'.
